dog.description_text: Offsite Notice: Pepsi Cola Pepsi Cola has just arrived in NYC and is currently staying at one of our trusted partners while they get settled. If you're interested in bringing Pepsi Cola home, click the Adopt button and complete the interest survey. Can't wait to add a new best friend to your family? We're thrilled to help you meet any of the pets at our center or you can sign up to foster today!
